reviewItem.question: Does "Fixed the `certmanager_certificate_renewal_timestamp_seconds` metric help text indicating that the metric is relative to expiration time, rather than Unix…" mean a change to protocol-behavior:cert-manager|name=certmanager-certificate-renewal-timestamp-seconds-help-text (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: The help text of the certmanager_certificate_renewal_timestamp_seconds metric was corrected to say it is a Unix epoch timestamp rather than relative to expiration time.
